authorization: Reuse only the 111 user-authorized vacant AIM IDs, within corresponding subject groups.
selection: Retained I>=6 pool; exact subject-category matches where possible; semantically appropriate controls, dynamics and geometry for broader published groups. Within comparable category pools, prioritize I, C, E, then finding key. No score changes.
review_scope: Each candidate's retained full statement, references and status discussion were read; fresh online queries checked for matching later complete results and announcements. Sources listed include retained primary comparators and sources surfaced online. The search log records retrieved snippets/selected primary passages. This is not an exhaustive proof of continued openness or a full proof audit of the cited literature.

records.title: Is there a uniform polynomial bound for three commuting contractions?
records.former_aim_title: Improve the worst-case tensor-train approximation factor
records.review_note: The uniform constant for arbitrary scalar polynomials and arbitrary Hilbert-space dimension is still distinguished from Hartz's homogeneous-polynomial theorem. The July 2026 Szász paper also says norm equivalence is unknown; no later complete result found.
records.current_title: Is there a uniform polynomial bound for three commuting contractions?

records.title: How many intensity measurements guarantee complex phase retrieval?
records.former_aim_title: Exact uniform control time near a viscous Burgers shock
records.review_note: The July 2026 announcement settles only M=4 (eleven measurements). Generic sufficiency, almost-everywhere recovery and Gaussian-frame assertions do not determine the global existence minimum for all dimensions.
records.current_title: How many intensity measurements guarantee complex phase retrieval?

records.title: Null control of a singular two-dimensional Grushin heat equation
records.former_aim_title: Interior smoothness of carrying simplices in competitive population maps
records.review_note: The current Lissy–Lourme result is one-dimensional. Vanlaere's singular-Grushin work concerns boundary singularities in 2D or interior singularities in higher dimension; no full answer for Morancey's transmitting 2D interior model found.
records.current_title: Null control of a singular two-dimensional Grushin heat equation

records.title: Uniform semi-limit-cycle bounds for continuous affine fields on planar grids
records.former_aim_title: The sharp Belgian chocolate stabilization threshold
records.review_note: Checked current Panazzolo-related work and the 2026 unbounded-canard paper. Holomorphic saddle loops, discontinuous switching fields and smooth regularizations do not give a uniform bound or counterexample for globally continuous affine fields on a fixed rectangular grid.
records.current_title: Uniform semi-limit-cycle bounds on planar grids

records.title: Horizontal gradient Holder regularity on arbitrary Carnot groups
records.former_aim_title: A single blow-up point for singular extremal states on convex domains
records.review_note: The arbitrary-step, all-exponent horizontal-gradient assertion remains beyond step-two/Heisenberg and restricted-exponent Riemannian-approximation theorems. Current searches found no complete arbitrary-Carnot resolution.
records.current_title: Horizontal gradient regularity on arbitrary Carnot groups

records.title: Rank-one and quasiconvex relaxation of two quadratic wells in the plane
records.former_aim_title: Largest radius ratio in nonuniform triangulated circle packings
records.review_note: The target allows distinct arbitrary anisotropic positive quadratic forms on full gradients. Results for symmetric strains, compatible finite-well sets, or one quadratic form do not establish the stated universal envelope equality; no complete newer resolution located.
records.current_title: Rank-one and quasiconvex relaxation of two quadratic wells in the plane

records.title: Strong unique continuation under a small local form bound
records.former_aim_title: Finitely many radius sets for compact sphere packings
records.review_note: Retains real L2-local potentials with a small local form bound in every dimension. Later many-body Lebesgue-potential UCP and non-interacting Hohenberg–Kohn results do not establish this high-dimensional general form-bound conjecture.
records.current_title: Strong unique continuation under a small local form bound

records.title: Cardy's crossing formula for the real planar Bargmann–Fock field
records.former_aim_title: Support growth of the information-maximizing binomial prior
records.review_note: Checked Beliaev's Gaussian-field discussion and recent Cardy searches. Lattice/random-cluster Cardy results and Bargmann–Fock RSW bounds do not identify the exact Gaussian-field rectangle limit.
records.current_title: Cardy's crossing formula for the real planar Bargmann–Fock field

records.title: Is the Brownian Lévy transformation ergodic?
records.former_aim_title: Tail bounds for causal equivalence classes of uniform random DAGs
records.review_note: The continuous Brownian half-line Lévy transformation is the target. Density/topological recurrence and sufficient conditions for exactness do not prove its ergodicity; no newer complete announcement found.
records.current_title: Is the Brownian Lévy transformation ergodic?

records.title: The thermal near-critical Ising spin-interface limit
records.former_aim_title: Mixing time of the reflected Burnside sampler for integer partitions
records.review_note: New 23 October 2026 paper by Yu Feng proves mutual absolute continuity with SLE3 for every subsequential thermal spin-interface limit, using uniformly controlled densities. It does not identify a unique full-sequence limit in all admissible Jordan domains. Thermal FK-interface and weak-interaction critical-universality announcements have different targets.
records.current_title: The thermal near-critical Ising spin-interface limit

records.title: The limit law of the most visited site of a planar random walk
records.former_aim_title: Monotonicity of draw probabilities under random vertex deletion
records.review_note: The first-exit maximum of planar random-walk local time is distinct from the wired-domain cover-time/last-vertex law. Searches found no matching complete scalar-maximum fluctuation theorem.
records.current_title: The limit law of the most visited site of a planar random walk

records.title: Cylinders for the symmetric Gaussian isoperimetric problem
records.former_aim_title: Extending a symmetric one-dependent four-color law across a branch
records.review_note: Heilman's cylinder classification assumes product minimality and retains an exceptional curvature case. These conditions and the near-zero/one-volume strip cases leave the arbitrary fixed-dimension cylinder/complement inequality unresolved.
records.current_title: Cylinders for the symmetric Gaussian isoperimetric problem

records.title: GOE fluctuations for a Brownian polymer in a Poisson environment
records.former_aim_title: Unimodality of Radon partitions for uniform convex samples
records.review_note: Fixed nonzero parameters and a free Brownian endpoint are essential. Intermediate-disorder limits and directed-landscape results conditional on KPZ convergence do not prove the GOE fluctuation conjecture for this Poisson polymer.
records.current_title: GOE fluctuations for a Brownian polymer in a Poisson environment

records.title: Does finite-state strong mixing force Bernoulli isomorphism?
records.former_aim_title: Fourth-order diffusion approximation for three-player ruin
records.review_note: Question is alpha-mixing of a finite-state stationary process implying Bernoulli isomorphism, with no rate. Beta-mixing, ordinary mixing and observable CLTs are different conditions/conclusions; the 2026 ICM discussion retains the question.
records.current_title: Does finite-state strong mixing force Bernoulli isomorphism?

records.title: The standard simplex inequality for negative Gaussian correlations
records.former_aim_title: Absolute continuity of stationary Elo ratings
records.review_note: The three-cell 2026 negative-correlation result covers only a subrange of correlations. It does not settle all q>=3 and -1<rho<0. Unequal-mass comparisons and conditional hyperstability classifications do not refute or prove the centered-simplex benchmark here.
records.current_title: The standard simplex inequality for negative Gaussian correlations

records.title: Hunt's hypothesis for driftless subordinators
records.former_aim_title: Oscillation of partition functions under very strong disorder
records.review_note: Known special driftless subordinators and decompositions into two clocks satisfying (H) do not imply (H) for every driftless infinite-activity subordinator; closure under arbitrary sums is not supplied.
records.current_title: Hunt's hypothesis for driftless subordinators

records.title: Polynomial-time mean estimation with simultaneous directional accuracy
records.former_aim_title: Monotone variance in the Gaussian approximation to DrMMD flow
records.review_note: The statistical existence theorem is not a polynomial-time algorithm. Direction-adaptive simultaneous accuracy with the spectral tail term is stronger than a Euclidean sub-Gaussian or a different Mahalanobis guarantee; no matching efficient construction located.
records.current_title: Polynomial-time mean estimation with simultaneous directional accuracy

records.title: Polynomial fewnomial root bounds in fixed dimension
records.former_aim_title: A discrete Aronson–Bénilan estimate for an upwind growth scheme
records.review_note: The October Descartes recursion and topological-degree bounds do not yield a worst-case polynomial bound for the unsigned number of nondegenerate positive roots at fixed dimension. Random-coefficient expectations and the disproved product bound are different targets.
records.current_title: Polynomial fewnomial root bounds in fixed dimension

records.title: Whitney extension with a 2^D test threshold and single-exponential loss
records.former_aim_title: Removing the logarithmic loss in the Li–Wu KdV integrator
records.review_note: The latest author version improves the extension loss at a larger test threshold; it retains the simultaneous 2^D and exp(poly(D)) question. No later matching result was located.
records.current_title: Whitney extension with a 2^D test threshold and single-exponential loss

records.title: Sharp uniform approximation of Lipschitz functions by shallow ReLU networks
records.former_aim_title: Linear inverse bounds for four-diamond scattering
records.review_note: The 2026 SIAM paper still has logarithmic losses. The September critical-Besov theorem imposes a bounded outer coefficient budget and different norms/classes; it does not establish the unrestricted Lipschitz-ball uniform lower bound.
records.current_title: Sharp uniform approximation of Lipschitz functions by shallow ReLU networks

records.title: Does adaptive Monte Carlo approximation of the universal noncompact embedding have a positive error floor?
records.former_aim_title: Removing the logarithmic loss in Helmholtz Nyström estimates
records.review_note: The September 2026 high-dimensional-vector article retains dimension dependence, albeit log log m, in adaptive bounds. It does not make the infinite-dimensional noncompact inclusion approximable, nor prove an adaptive error floor in the expected-budget RMS model.
records.current_title: Can adaptive Monte Carlo approximate a noncompact operator?

records.title: Arbitrarily slow strong approximation of a scalar autonomous SDE with smooth bounded coefficients
records.former_aim_title: Existence for adaptive porous flow with a negative drag jump
records.review_note: Arbitrarily slow approximation is known in dimension two and above. The recent scalar survey explicitly asks the autonomous one-dimensional smooth bounded case; results with Lipschitz drift, time-irregular coefficients or a particular scheme do not settle it.
records.current_title: Arbitrarily slow strong approximation of a smooth scalar stochastic equation

records.title: Optimal cubature error with small mixed smoothness in dimensions at least three
records.former_aim_title: Sharp asymptotic constant for rational approximation of fractional inverse powers
records.review_note: Searches retain the small-mixed-smoothness lower-bound gap. Frolov upper bounds, two-dimensional optimality, quantum Besov integration and particular-rule estimates do not settle unrestricted deterministic cubature in dimensions >=3.
records.current_title: Optimal cubature error with small mixed smoothness

records.title: Linear-size equal-weight discretization of the L1 norm
records.former_aim_title: A fixed-time lower bound for Trotter splitting of the hydrogen ground state
records.review_note: The October 2026 survey retains removal of the logarithmic overhead for p<2. Uniform-norm hyperbolic-cross discretization, weighted rules and L2 sparsification are not the two-sided equal-weight L1 statement under the stated Nikolskii bound.
records.current_title: Linear-size equal-weight discretization of the L1 norm

records.title: A linear individual-budget information bound for arbitrary convex model classes
records.former_aim_title: Sharp permutation bound for triangular parts of correlation matrices
records.review_note: Ullrich's 2026 all-s-number result treats symmetric operator balls. Its nonsymmetric convex-set extension yields a linear factor for Hilbert targets and a larger factor in general; it does not supply the requested general Banach-target randomized-error estimate.
records.current_title: A linear information bound for arbitrary convex model classes

records.title: Does discontinuous information help randomized approximation?
records.former_aim_title: A sharp Galerkin projection bound on nonobtuse triangles
records.review_note: The original randomized continuous-versus-algebraic-linear information question remains distinct from its solved worst-case counterparts. The 2026 survey uses different budget/error/measurability conventions; no exact-model resolution found.
records.current_title: Does discontinuous information help randomized approximation?

records.title: Do rounded expanding-circle simulations recover the physical measure at intermediate times?
records.former_aim_title: Optimal uniform observation time for mixed finite element waves
records.review_note: The later circle-discretization theory fixes the iteration time before the grid limit. It does not prove generic convergence for every growing sequence log N << m << sqrt N; simulations are not such a theorem.
records.current_title: Intermediate-time recovery of the physical measure under deterministic rounding

records.title: Sharp noisy continuous-information complexity for an infinite-dimensional Sobolev ellipsoid
records.former_aim_title: Strong convergence rate of the fractional WIS Euler integrator
records.review_note: The published noisy-information paper leaves the infinite-dimensional diagonal example open. Noise-free exponential accuracy and fixed-noise polynomial order do not give the joint n,delta asymptotic with uniform constants.
records.current_title: Sharp complexity of noisy continuous sensing of a Sobolev ellipsoid

records.title: Sharp uniform approximation widths for small mixed Hölder smoothness
records.former_aim_title: Logarithmic controlled bandwidth for locally analytic functions
records.review_note: The d>=3 small-mixed-Holder question asks a Kolmogorov lower bound in the uniform target norm over every linear approximation space. Stronger Besov target norms, nonlinear sparse approximation and fixed-subspace errors do not supply it; no complete later result located.
records.current_title: Sharp uniform approximation widths for small mixed Hölder smoothness

records.title: The Singer conjecture for all closed aspherical manifolds
records.former_aim_title: Ergodicity of higher-dimensional Ising clumps
records.review_note: The official September announcement is restricted to formal dimension four. The general all-dimensional topological-manifold Singer statement remains beyond that theorem and the 2026 semismall-Albanese cases.
records.current_title: The Singer conjecture for all closed aspherical manifolds

records.title: Does every nonseparating plane continuum have the fixed-point property?
records.former_aim_title: Exact diameter of the leaf-slide graph on labelled trees
records.review_note: The unrestricted continuous-self-map plane-continuum problem is distinct from Cartwright–Littlewood theorems for maps extending to plane homeomorphisms. The 2025 primary article retains it; no complete newer announcement located.
records.current_title: The plane fixed-point problem for nonseparating continua

records.title: Must every smooth volume-preserving flow on the three-sphere have a periodic orbit?
records.former_aim_title: Exponential excursion tails for topology-preserving Ising disks
records.review_note: Kuperberg's volume-preserving aperiodic construction is C1; unrestricted smooth counterexamples do not preserve volume. The smooth conservative S3 question remains separate from Reeb/contact and singular-contact variants.
records.current_title: Must every smooth volume-preserving flow on the three-sphere have a periodic orbit?

records.title: Can a closed Ricci-flat manifold have full rotation holonomy?
records.former_aim_title: Wedge-of-spheres structure of path-product matching complexes
records.review_note: Complete noncompact full-holonomy examples and positive-Einstein constructions do not construct a closed simply connected Ricci-flat SO(n)-holonomy manifold or exclude all such manifolds.
records.current_title: Can a closed Ricci-flat manifold have full rotation holonomy?

records.title: Markus's affine completeness conjecture
records.former_aim_title: Monotonicity of connectivity in spherical Rips filtrations
records.review_note: The apparent full Markus proof remains withdrawn in the current official arXiv record (v3). Ray-holonomy, centralizing-holonomy and metric special cases do not settle arbitrary volume-preserving affine connections.
records.current_title: Markus's affine completeness conjecture

records.title: Uniqueness of tangent cones for stationary integral varifolds
records.former_aim_title: Six-point persistence on the Euclidean two-sphere
records.review_note: Current cylindrical-cone uniqueness and near-multiplicity-two-plane theorems retain tangent-model or structural assumptions. Almost-everywhere regularity/singular-dimension announcements do not establish uniqueness at every singular point for Euclidean stationary integral varifolds.
records.current_title: Uniqueness of tangent cones for stationary integral varifolds

records.title: Uniqueness of positive Einstein metrics on the standard four-sphere
records.former_aim_title: Homology at the second transition of torus-grid Rips complexes
records.review_note: Positive-sectional-curvature classifications and torus-symmetric or twistor-curvature theorems do not classify arbitrary positive Einstein metrics on standard S4. No active unrestricted resolution located; the torus-symmetry preprint's withdrawal is retained.
records.current_title: Uniqueness of the positive Einstein metric on the four-sphere

records.title: Does Hermitian–symplectic imply Kähler on a compact complex manifold?
records.former_aim_title: Homotopy type of torus-grid Rips complexes at half the diameter
records.review_note: The October 2026 Streets–Tian announcement assumes compact homogeneous quotient structure. Nilmanifold, solvmanifold and surface cases leave arbitrary compact complex manifolds of dimension >=3 outside their scope.
records.current_title: Does Hermitian–symplectic imply Kähler on a compact complex manifold?

records.title: The Eisenbud-Goto regularity bound for smooth complex projective varieties
records.former_aim_title: Motion-planning complexity of symmetric products of non-orientable surfaces
records.review_note: The 2026 projectively-normal theorem has extra embedding/singularity hypotheses. Singular counterexamples and Ulrich-sheaf counterexamples are not smooth ideal-sheaf regularity counterexamples to this precise arbitrary-embedding question.
records.current_title: The Eisenbud-Goto regularity bound for smooth complex projective varieties

records.title: Gromov zero-real-simplicial-volume Euler characteristic conjecture
records.former_aim_title: Betti numbers of a persistence fiber with no finite bars
records.review_note: New 23 October 2026 angle-cocycle paper proves the implication under immersed straightening, including convex-projective manifolds. It does not prove every aspherical topological manifold admits such a structure. Nonpositively curved four-dimensional and scalar-curvature comparisons are likewise restricted.
records.current_title: Does zero simplicial volume force zero Euler characteristic?

records.title: Closed geodesics on complete manifolds of finite volume
records.former_aim_title: Monotonicity of connectivity in spherical Čech filtrations
records.review_note: Compact closed-geodesic infinitude, hyperbolic finite-volume theorems and geodesic flowers under end conditions do not imply a smooth periodic geodesic on every complete noncompact finite-volume manifold of dimension >=3.
records.current_title: Closed geodesics on complete manifolds of finite volume

records.title: Does finite geodesic blocking force a closed manifold to be flat?
records.former_aim_title: A 325-point two-distance set in dimension 24
records.review_note: Known finite-blocking flatness results impose nonpositive curvature, no conjugate points or regularity/separation of blockers. Translation-surface classifications permit conical singularities and do not classify arbitrary smooth Riemannian metrics.
records.current_title: Does finite blocking of geodesics force a closed manifold to be flat?

records.title: Uniqueness of the embedded genus-one self-shrinker in three dimensions
records.former_aim_title: Uniqueness of 277-point two-distance sets in dimension 23
records.review_note: The September 2026 profile-curve paper still leaves Angenent-torus uniqueness open. Noncompact genus-one shrinkers and tangent-flow uniqueness do not produce a compact embedded counterexample or classify all compact genus-one shrinkers.
records.current_title: Uniqueness of the closed genus-one self-shrinker in three dimensions

records.title: Lawson–Kusner minimisers of Willmore energy in every genus
records.former_aim_title: Minimal persistence grids versus homological Morse lower bounds
records.review_note: The 2026 surfaces-with-symmetry result retains group symmetry. Fixed-conformal-class, higher-codimension and other-topology statements do not prove the unrestricted genus-g Lawson lower bound with its equality classification.
records.current_title: Lawson surfaces as Willmore minimizers in every higher genus

records.title: A real-analytic unstable nonresonant elliptic equilibrium with two degrees of freedom
records.former_aim_title: Improving the exponential lower bound for peeling sequences
records.review_note: Analytic unstable elliptic equilibria are constructed in higher degrees of freedom; two-degree examples cited here have weaker regularity. The September 2026 density theorem requires at least five degrees and does not provide this analytic two-degree example.
records.current_title: Can a nonresonant elliptic equilibrium be unstable in an analytic two-degree Hamiltonian?

records.title: The sharp few-distance bound in every finite-dimensional normed space
records.former_aim_title: Counting half-integral polygons with collinear interior lattice points
records.review_note: The planar, parallelotope and equilateral cases are known. Euclidean or specified lp-norm theorems do not prove the bound and rigidity for all finite-dimensional norms; no matching general announcement located.
records.current_title: Sharp few-distance bound for arbitrary normed spaces

records.title: Does mixing force exponential decay for smooth Anosov flows?
records.former_aim_title: Counting Ehrhart quasipolynomials of half-integral polygons
records.review_note: The Annals theorem settles dimension three; contact, codimension-one and inducing-scheme results add hypotheses. New examples of exponentially mixing flows and discrete Anosov-map results do not prove exponential mixing for every smooth mixing Anosov flow in all dimensions.
records.current_title: Does mixing force exponential decay for smooth Anosov flows?

records.title: Can a Heisenberg surface be more than one-half Hölder?
records.former_aim_title: A sharp Betti-number bound for 4-manifold triangulation complexity
records.review_note: The current Holder nonembedding results impose extra Euclidean regularity in the gap above 1/2. Holder maps constructed below 2/3 need not be injective; the purported 2016 solution remains withdrawn.
records.current_title: Can a Heisenberg surface be more than one-half Hölder?

records.title: Does lower one-dimensional density above one half force planar rectifiability?
records.former_aim_title: Sharp vertex bounds for generalized triangulations in even dimensions
records.review_note: Density-threshold improvements are partial and do not reach the strict planar >1/2 criterion. Higher-dimensional examples attain equality at 1/2 and are not counterexamples to the strict planar formulation.
records.current_title: Does lower one-dimensional density above one half force planar rectifiability?

records.title: Freeness of real hyperplane arrangements from their intersection lattice
records.former_aim_title: The happy-edge conjecture for convex plane spanning trees
records.review_note: The October 15/16-line theorem handles only small complex rank-three arrangements. Numerical/generalized variants and conic-line counterexamples do not give a real free/nonfree hyperplane pair with the same full intersection lattice.
records.current_title: Freeness of real hyperplane arrangements from their intersection lattice

records.title: The minimizing Sard conjecture for smooth sub-Riemannian structures
records.former_aim_title: A sharp differing-edge bound for convex plane-tree flips
records.review_note: Known Goh-rank/corank/generic cases and analytic variants do not settle arbitrary smooth minimizing Sard. The September and October endpoint-map counterexamples explicitly distinguish nonminimizing abnormal curves from this minimizing assertion.
records.current_title: The minimizing Sard conjecture for smooth sub-Riemannian structures

records.title: Local homogeneity of compact holomorphic Riemannian manifolds
records.former_aim_title: Three or four layers for 2-degenerate graphs
records.review_note: Kahler, complex-threefold and 2026 Vaisman Calabi–Yau cases add hypotheses. Fundamental-group restrictions and statements about more general affine tensors do not imply local homogeneity of every compact holomorphic Riemannian metric.
records.current_title: Local homogeneity of compact holomorphic Riemannian manifolds

records.title: The Berge conjecture for integral lens-space surgeries
records.former_aim_title: A linear threshold for extracting a segment grid
records.review_note: September 2026 result verifies Berge for genus <=5; the tunnel-number-one theorem is another restricted case. Lens-space realization and purely cosmetic surgery assertions do not classify all knots admitting an integer lens-space surgery.
records.current_title: The Berge conjecture for integral lens-space surgeries

records.title: Projective-space rigidity for self-maps of Picard-one Fano manifolds
records.former_aim_title: The minimum vertex number of a triangulation of real projective 5-space
records.review_note: The 2026 fourfold work covers currently known families, and the newer polarized Galois theorem adds a Galois condition. Neither settles all smooth Picard-one Fano manifolds and arbitrary degree>1 self-maps.
records.current_title: Projective-space rigidity for self-maps of Picard-one Fano manifolds

records.title: Square-root error in the modular prime geodesic theorem
records.former_aim_title: Counting cospherical tuples in lattice cubes
records.review_note: The October modular prime-geodesic improvement still has exponent above 1/2. Congruence-class, averaged, weighted and Bianchi-manifold estimates do not establish this fixed modular-group pointwise square-root error.
records.current_title: Square-root error in the modular prime geodesic theorem

records.title: Must a closed nonconstant CPE metric be Einstein?
records.former_aim_title: Relative density of sets generated by fixed-parameter extrapolation
records.review_note: Current CPE results impose dimension, curvature, contact or stability hypotheses. An Einstein classification assumes the desired conclusion and cannot prove it for every nonconstant CPE metric; withdrawn full claims are not accepted.
records.current_title: Must a closed nonconstant CPE metric be Einstein?

records.title: Does every closed topological four-manifold have a CW structure?
records.former_aim_title: Topological complexity in the homogeneous medial regime for all sample sizes
records.review_note: An actual CW structure on the given closed four-manifold is stronger than finite-CW homotopy type. The 2025 monograph and later topology discussion retain the distinction; Borel-rigidity counterexamples do not answer it.
records.current_title: Does every closed topological four-manifold have a CW structure?

records.title: Local smooth closing for arbitrary Euclidean hypersurfaces
records.former_aim_title: A finite three-ample complex with nontrivial fundamental group
records.review_note: Current closing results cover contact-type, ellipsoid, near-periodic and other restricted Hamiltonian settings. They do not supply the specified compatible symplectic form and residual graph statement for every compact Euclidean hypersurface.
records.current_title: Local smooth closing for arbitrary Euclidean hypersurfaces

records.title: Higher-regularity density of stable ergodicity
records.former_aim_title: Location of the most isolated point in a random polyhedral sample
records.review_note: C1-density is known; higher-regularity results add center-bunching/coherence or center-dimension assumptions. The October expanding-on-average theorem is likewise restricted and does not prove general Cr-density for each r>=2.
records.current_title: Higher-regularity density of stable ergodicity

records.title: Must positive finite density for an arbitrary norm have integer dimension in dimension three and higher?
records.former_aim_title: Vanishing threshold for first path homology of a random digraph
records.review_note: The arbitrary-norm theorem is planar. Higher-dimensional Euclidean density integrality and fixed-integer-dimensional rectifiability in strictly convex Banach spaces do not prove integrality for all norms in dimension >=3.
records.current_title: Must positive finite density for an arbitrary norm have integer dimension in dimension three and higher?

records.title: Hyperkahler rigidity of simply connected Ricci-flat ALE four-manifolds
records.former_aim_title: Central limit theorem for the first path Betti number
records.review_note: The current October ALE revision assumes both toric and Hermitian structure. Almost-Kahler and prescribed-end/kernel cases also add hypotheses absent from the general simply connected Ricci-flat ALE question.
records.current_title: Hyperkähler rigidity of simply connected Ricci-flat ALE four-manifolds

records.title: Large Lipschitz graph pieces from single-scale projections
records.former_aim_title: Path connectivity of the infinity Z-Gromov–Wasserstein space
records.review_note: The all-scales big-projection theorem is known and the planar single-scale branch is announced. Neither the planar theorem nor stronger projected-measure bounds settle the n>=2 single-scale projected-set lower-bound question.
records.current_title: Large Lipschitz graph pieces from single-scale projections

records.title: Does the Mumford–Shah calibration dual always attain the segmentation energy?
records.former_aim_title: Maximum treewidth at a prescribed edge count
records.review_note: Regularity/classification of planar Mumford–Shah minimizers is not equality with the calibration dual. The source's gapless-duality conjecture for this jump-energy functional remains beyond integral-functional and thermal-insulation calibration results.
records.current_title: Does the Mumford–Shah calibration dual always attain the segmentation energy?

records.title: Does cyclic monotonicity imply optimality for finite Borel multi-marginal costs?
records.former_aim_title: Classifying balanced elementary symmetric Boolean functions
records.review_note: The 2025 multi-marginal optimality theorem still assumes continuous cost. Borel two-marginal results and infinite-valued multi-marginal counterexamples do not decide the finite nonnegative Borel case with an integrable marginal-sum bound.
records.current_title: Does cyclic monotonicity imply optimality for finite Borel multi-marginal costs?

records.title: Polynomial-query convex optimization with almost linear memory
records.former_aim_title: The sharp asymptotic facial length in girth-saturated plane graphs
records.review_note: July 2026 memory/query lower bounds force larger polynomial exponents, not superpolynomial queries for every exponent. Feasibility-oracle lower bounds do not automatically transfer to the narrower global-minimizer first-order model; no matching complete answer found.
records.current_title: Polynomial-query convex optimization with almost linear memory

records.title: BFGS convergence for a quadratic plus an absolute value
records.former_aim_title: A linear genus–girth bound for facial cycles
records.review_note: The 2026 nonsmooth quasi-Newton paper retains assumptions on matrix eigenvalues that are not established for all executions. Smooth-convex, isolated-nonsmooth-minimum, one-dimensional rate and modified/L-BFGS results do not prove the u^2+|v| all-Armijo–Wolfe-sequence conjecture.
records.current_title: BFGS convergence for a quadratic plus an absolute value

records.title: No suboptimal local minima in relaxed two-phase elastic compliance
records.former_aim_title: The symmetry point of a unimodular lattice's secrecy function
records.review_note: New light-structure relaxation results and free-material global-value/laminate results do not prove absence of suboptimal strong-L2 local stress minima for this fixed multiplier, ordered-isotropic two-phase relaxed compliance functional.
records.current_title: No suboptimal local minima in relaxed two-phase elastic compliance

records.title: Weak convergence of subcritical inertial convex gradient trajectories
records.former_aim_title: Excluding three correlation levels in quadratic field towers
records.review_note: The corrected January 2026 Jang–Ryu version does not retain its earlier subcritical convergence argument. Critical damping alpha=3, rates for objective values, and bounded/strong-minimum special cases do not prove arbitrary-Hilbert weak convergence for 1<alpha<3.
records.current_title: Weak convergence under subcritical vanishing damping

records.title: A multimarginal Minty converse for maximal c-monotone sets
records.former_aim_title: Permutation snarks with order congruent to six modulo eight
records.review_note: Minty criteria giving maximality from surjective sum, or contact sets with splitting potentials, do not prove the converse for every maximally c-monotone set. Lim's nonmaximal example does not refute this premise.
records.current_title: A multimarginal Minty converse

records.title: Does the standard Nelder-Mead method always converge on x²+y²?
records.former_aim_title: Permutation snarks without five-cycles
records.review_note: The original expansion-including algorithm and every nondegenerate starting triangle are required. Restricted Nelder–Mead, quantitative step-frequency conditions, common-value convergence and 2026 statistical parameter heuristics do not prove convergence to the quadratic minimizer.
records.current_title: Does the standard Nelder–Mead method always converge on x²+y²?

records.title: What is the one-dimensional convex-bandit minimax cumulative regret?
records.former_aim_title: Removable cycles in cycle permutation graphs
records.review_note: The one-dimensional minimax result is sharp up to logarithms; the requested exact order includes those factors for noisy bounded convex losses. Higher-dimensional hidden-curvature bounds and pseudo-1D models do not remove the remaining logarithmic uncertainty.
records.current_title: What is the one-dimensional convex-bandit minimax cumulative regret?

records.title: Generic one-to-one boundary parametrization of the SDP-exact distance region
records.former_aim_title: Smallest orders for periodic multidimensional Costas arrays
records.review_note: The exactness-region degree formula divides by an unknown projection degree. Reported computations, local Voronoi results and generic quadratic-optimization algebraic degrees do not prove generic componentwise degree one for every 2<=m<=n.
records.current_title: Generic one-to-one boundary parametrization of the SDP-exact distance region

records.title: Indicator Gabor orthonormal bases force tiling and spectrality
records.former_aim_title: Strict angle monotonicity of magnetic wedge ground energy
records.review_note: Liehr's 2026 compact-support classification assumes a one-dimensional lattice; product/separable results are also restricted. The nonproduct-window counterexample is not an indicator window. No theorem for arbitrary finite-measure sets and arbitrary countable time-frequency sets found.
records.current_title: Does an indicator Gabor basis force tiling and spectrality?

records.title: Payne's Dirichlet–buckling comparison in Euclidean domains
records.former_aim_title: Is the optimal magnetic rectangle always a square?
records.review_note: The 28 September 2026 version of Levitin and Polterovich proves odd buckling indices in the plane and some even indices with adjacent equal buckling eigenvalues. The 14 October 2026 Buoso-Lotoreichik paper explicitly leaves the general even planar case open; its counterexamples concern intrinsic manifolds, not Euclidean domains. The older all-index proof was withdrawn after an identified Lemma 4.2 error. Fresh searches through 30 October 2026 found no matching complete resolution or announced solution of the stated all-dimensional Euclidean comparison.
records.current_title: Payne's Dirichlet–buckling comparison in Euclidean domains

records.title: Compact resolvent for kinetic Fokker–Planck and Witten operators
records.former_aim_title: Nonempty spectrum for a magnetic complex Airy operator at every field strength
records.review_note: The arbitrary-smooth-potential compact-resolvent implication is broader than polynomial or derivative-growth hypotheses. Local maximal hypoellipticity and electromagnetic compactness criteria do not automatically prove Helffer–Nier's full implication.
records.current_title: Compact resolvent for kinetic Fokker–Planck and Witten operators

records.title: Sharp Li-Yau eigenvalue-sum bound for varying magnetic fields
records.former_aim_title: Reality of the spectrum for a spherical strip with PT-symmetric boundary conditions
records.review_note: The sharp constant-field sum inequality is known. Variable-field bounds at Riesz order >=3/2, or different constants, do not prove the stated sharp order-one Li–Yau inequality for arbitrary smooth magnetic fields.
records.current_title: Does the sharp Li–Yau bound hold for varying magnetic fields?

records.title: A continuous spectral symmetrization path for every domain
records.former_aim_title: Excess Floquet multiplicity for complex periodic Schrödinger equations
records.review_note: The source still leaves general domains open. Polyhedral-domain and nested-domain paths do not simultaneously provide fixed volume, both functional monotonicities and full gamma-continuity for every bounded open domain.
records.current_title: A continuous spectral symmetrization path for every domain

records.title: The sharp first Steklov eigenvalue with fixed boundary area
records.former_aim_title: Completeness of modes for slowly growing imaginary Schrödinger potentials
records.review_note: The 2026 sharp mixed boundary-area/volume normalization is different from sigma1 times boundary area^(1/(n-1)). Fixed-volume product, convex-only, exterior and manifold-metric results do not determine this supremum over all smooth Euclidean domains.
records.current_title: The sharp first Steklov eigenvalue with fixed boundary area

records.title: Planar bounded measurable conductivity from one arbitrary boundary patch
records.former_aim_title: Uniqueness of nonnegative heat controls at the minimum time
records.review_note: Full-boundary rough planar uniqueness, local smooth uniqueness and fractional exterior-data results have different hypotheses. The earlier anisotropic planar local theorem uses both local DN and ND maps; it does not establish this one arbitrary-patch map for L-infinity conductivities.
records.current_title: Recovering a rough planar conductivity from one boundary patch

records.title: Does fixed noise select a unique inviscid fluid law?
records.former_aim_title: An extreme solitary wave for the bidirectional Whitham system
records.review_note: Subsequential Euler-invariant limits are known. Dependence on a changed viscosity exponent and effective finite-dimensional observable dynamics do not settle sequence independence of the full velocity law with one fixed noise covariance and the fixed Laplacian.
records.current_title: Does fixed noise select a unique inviscid fluid law?

records.title: Global smooth evolution for the periodic De Gregorio equation
records.former_aim_title: Polynomial decay for KdV with three critical linear modes
records.review_note: The current periodic smooth-data De Gregorio problem is broader than symmetry/sign classes. Instability of excited states, lower-regularity periodic blowup and real-line self-similar profiles do not resolve arbitrary smooth data on the circle.
records.current_title: Global smooth evolution for the periodic De Gregorio equation

records.title: Quasi-invariance of independent-Fourier Gaussian laws under 2D Euler
records.former_aim_title: Best convex shape for insulation of fixed thickness and perimeter
records.review_note: The August 2026 classification proves invariance generally and the quasi-invariance equivalence only for finitely many active directions. A prescribed transport-flow obstruction is not Euler's self-consistent Gaussian flow. The infinitely-many-directions quasi-invariance target remains beyond these theorems.
records.current_title: Quasi-invariance of independent-Fourier Gaussian laws under 2D Euler

records.title: Uniqueness of divergence-free transport with bounded-deformation velocity
records.former_aim_title: An algebraic vanishing-noise rate for kinetic mean-field games
records.review_note: The October regular-Lagrangian-flow theorem requires special BD and extra time regularity. BV theory, Euler energy conservation and fractional-Sobolev counterexamples do not establish uniqueness for every prescribed divergence-free L1-time BD velocity with arbitrary Cantor part.
records.current_title: Uniqueness of divergence-free transport with bounded-deformation velocity

records.title: Energy-admissible weak solutions of the undamped hyperbolic p-Laplacian from smooth data
records.former_aim_title: Intercritical norm inflation for the dispersion-managed Schrödinger equation
records.review_note: Current hyperbolic p-Laplacian results add damping, sources or higher-order regularization. Local classical existence and measure-valued limits do not give or refute a global ordinary constitutive-flux, energy-admissible weak solution for every smooth multidimensional datum.
records.current_title: Energy-admissible weak solutions of the undamped hyperbolic p-Laplacian from smooth data

records.title: Time analyticity of trajectories for bounded-vorticity Euler flows
records.former_aim_title: Positive equilibrium attraction for an irreversible catalytic reaction
records.review_note: Yudovich existence and smooth/Gevrey trajectories are known, but not their real analyticity for every bounded vorticity. Holder-vorticity, regular-vortex-patch and different phase-space analyticity theorems add hypotheses.
records.current_title: Time analyticity of trajectories for bounded-vorticity Euler flows

records.title: A single critical activity for the continuum Widom–Rowlinson model
records.former_aim_title: Coexistence in a three-strain colicin model
records.review_note: The fixed-temperature continuum percolation sharpness theorem does not locate a unique Gibbs-state threshold on the symmetric diagonal z=beta=lambda. Large-activity coexistence and random-field lattice results leave the full diagonal uniqueness/nonuniqueness assertion unresolved.
records.current_title: A single critical activity for the continuum Widom–Rowlinson model

records.title: The strong Markov property for continuum dynamical percolation
records.former_aim_title: Selection of the carbon-monoxide poisoning phase
records.review_note: The question is the stationary continuum scaling limit with its specified exceptional-state extension and natural filtration. Ordinary Markov, Liouville variants and Voronoi crossing/universality results do not establish this exact strong Markov assertion.
records.current_title: The strong Markov property for continuum dynamical percolation

records.title: When is a random tree built by attaching prescribed branches compact?
records.former_aim_title: A continuous strictly decreasing moment spectrum for Gaussian polymers
records.review_note: Known monotone/summable/regularly varying branch-length criteria and the 2026 discrete-aggregation results do not give a necessary and sufficient compactness criterion for every bounded deterministic sequence in the continuous uniform-length attachment model.
records.current_title: When is a random tree built by attaching prescribed branches compact?

records.title: Is the Brownian queue transformation ergodic or Bernoulli?
records.former_aim_title: Accuracy of parsimony reconstruction under a molecular clock
records.review_note: The discrete M/M/1 transformation is Bernoulli and the Brownian map has a Bernoulli factor. Neither proves ergodicity or Bernoulli isomorphism of the entire two-sided continuous Brownian-with-positive-drift transformation.
records.current_title: Is the Brownian queue transformation ergodic or Bernoulli?

records.title: Quantum transport in a dilute periodic potential
records.former_aim_title: The sharp decay rate for waves damped on a disk
records.review_note: The low-density periodic quantum limit is known to low perturbative orders or conditional on lattice statistics, and with added damping. These are not the unconditional fixed-coupling h=r trace limit in the target.
records.current_title: Quantum transport in a dilute periodic potential

records.title: Can one small initial velocity component prevent Navier-Stokes blow-up?
records.former_aim_title: Can every bounded entire Burgers profile recur at late times?
records.review_note: One-component space-time criteria and symmetry-breaking/norm inflation do not answer the unconditional initial-component question. General blowup announcements do not assert arbitrarily small critical H1/2 size of one initial component in this working class; modified, forced or anisotropically dissipative equations have different hypotheses.
records.current_title: Can one small initial velocity component prevent Navier–Stokes blow-up?

records.title: Weak uniqueness for general Maxwell-Stefan diffusion
records.former_aim_title: Existence of an optimal asymmetric Bloch wall of prescribed angle
records.review_note: The general entropy weak-class target removes bounded-flux or smooth-reference assumptions. The current renormalized theorem requires bounded fluxes; whole-space weak existence and additive-friction strong results do not give arbitrary-coefficient weak uniqueness including vacuum.
records.current_title: Weak uniqueness for general Maxwell–Stefan diffusion

records.title: Global minimality of the radial hedgehog for unequal Frank constants
records.former_aim_title: Uniqueness of a hemispheric saddle profile on a magnetic sphere
records.review_note: The September Bousquet–Lamy result enlarges a sufficient global regime but retains a gap; its stronger explicit condition restricts competitors. Isotropic p-energies, second-variation stability and boundary regularity do not determine the full two-parameter global-minimality region.
records.current_title: Global minimality of the radial hedgehog for unequal Frank constants

records.title: Are nonequilibrium energy correlations governed by the inverse fractional heat operator?
records.former_aim_title: Uniqueness of positive reaction–diffusion equilibria outside two obstacles
records.review_note: The August boundary-thermalization work studies macroscopic superdiffusive transport, not the exact nonequilibrium fourth-order stationary energy covariance in the proposed inverse-operator formula. Neither a profile hydrodynamic limit nor local equilibrium proves that nonlocal covariance assertion.
records.current_title: Are nonequilibrium energy correlations governed by the inverse fractional heat operator?

records.title: A sharp entropy–dissipation inequality for planar fractional-pressure diffusion
records.former_aim_title: Finite propagation in fourth-order aggregation–diffusion
records.review_note: The one-dimensional entropy-dissipation result uses displacement convexity absent in the plane. Higher-dimensional existence/discrete dissipation or different fractional fast-diffusion functionals do not establish this sharp whole-plane Riesz-energy inequality.
records.current_title: A sharp entropy–dissipation inequality for planar fractional-pressure diffusion

records.title: Global classical continuation for a fully coupled SKT population model
records.former_aim_title: Full-space minimizers for subcritical fourth-order aggregation energy
records.review_note: The general periodic fully coupled three-dimensional SKT continuation question survives the 2026 local corrigendum. Triangular diffusion, equal base diffusivities, diagonal models or approximation conditional on a smooth reference impose extra assumptions.
records.current_title: Global classical continuation for a fully coupled SKT population model

records.title: Magnetic Hopf rigidity on higher-dimensional tori
records.former_aim_title: The shortest space curve of prescribed minimum width
records.review_note: The magnetic torus target uses Bialy's full ambient vertical no-conjugate-points convention in dimension >=3. The 2025 magnetic-curvature theorem retains an integral equality/curvature condition, and later entropy theorems add no-focal-point hypotheses. Conformally flat and zero-field cases do not settle arbitrary metrics.
records.current_title: Magnetic Hopf rigidity on higher-dimensional tori

records.title: Do dihedral angles determine a convex hyperbolic polyhedron globally?
records.former_aim_title: Maximum convex-hull volume for a closed curve of fixed length
records.review_note: Global hyperbolic polyhedron rigidity is stronger than infinitesimal/local rigidity. Euclidean dihedral-rigidity theorems, spherical counterexamples and conditional implications from the volume conjecture do not settle the exact hyperbolic global assertion.
records.current_title: Do dihedral angles determine a convex hyperbolic polyhedron globally?

records.title: The Calabi-Croke inequality for smooth Riemannian two-spheres
records.former_aim_title: A sharp surface-area bound for the convex hull of a closed curve
records.review_note: The global smooth Riemannian S2 inequality is distinct from singular Finsler counterexamples, punctured-sphere sharp bounds and local Zoll optimality. The 2026 geodesic-dynamics primary discussion retains Calabi's bound as a conjecture.
records.current_title: The Calabi–Croke inequality for smooth Riemannian two-spheres

records.title: Birkhoff retrograde global-section conjecture at all subcritical parameters
records.former_aim_title: Asymptotic density of reflected wavefronts in a disk
records.review_note: The current near-equal-mass theorem covers all subcritical energies only for mu near 1/2; the Hill theorem is a limiting model. They do not give disk-like global sections for every finite mass ratio.
records.current_title: Birkhoff's retrograde global-section conjecture across the finite-mass range

records.title: A perfectly conducting obstacle from one electromagnetic plane wave
records.former_aim_title: A closed nonplanar totally integrable wire billiard in three-space
records.review_note: Polyhedral, ball and waveguide results do not determine a general smooth PEC obstacle from one fixed-frequency/direction/polarization plane wave. The broad 2016 claim remains withdrawn; acoustic and elastic boundary conditions are different.
records.current_title: A perfectly conducting obstacle from one electromagnetic plane wave

records.title: Scalar geodesic tomography on nontrapping surfaces with conjugate points
records.former_aim_title: Observability of an acoustic shell at equal bulk and surface speeds
records.review_note: Real-analytic or piecewise-constant injectivity, higher-dimensional convex-foliation results and microlocal cancellation of singularities do not prove qualitative unweighted injectivity for every smooth nontrapping surface allowing conjugate points.
records.current_title: Scalar geodesic tomography on nontrapping surfaces with conjugate points

records.title: Is geometric visibility enough for conditional wave continuation from boundary Cauchy data?
records.former_aim_title: Boundary observation of a Schrödinger field with slower surface dispersion
records.review_note: The source gives conditional boundary-Cauchy estimates under pseudoconvexity/foliation hypotheses and special-case sharpness. Interior volumetric observations and qualitative unique continuation do not identify the optimal boundary-observed conditional-Holder region solely from visibility.
records.current_title: Is geometric visibility enough for conditional wave continuation from boundary Cauchy data?

records.title: Holomorphic convexity of transport twistor spaces of Anosov surfaces
records.former_aim_title: The sharp local maneuvering time for a shallow-water tank
records.review_note: Current transport-twistor biholomorphism rigidity, local blow-downs and constant-curvature/perturbative coordinate results do not imply compact holomorphic hulls for every compact subset of every Anosov-surface transport twistor interior.
records.current_title: Holomorphic convexity of transport twistor spaces of Anosov surfaces

records.title: Can one bending experiment locate a cavity in an elastic plate?
records.former_aim_title: Exact null control of a harmonically confined kinetic equation from a wedge
records.review_note: The 2026 exterior biharmonic-cavity paper uses an unbounded plate and two measurement sets. In-plane elasticity, time-harmonic scattering and one-measurement outer-boundary/rigid-inclusion results do not settle one static bending experiment for a free interior cavity in a bounded plate.
records.current_title: Can one bending experiment locate a cavity in an elastic plate?

records.title: Can one Dirichlet spectrum determine a Caputo potential?
records.former_aim_title: Approximate velocity control of a viscoelastic fluid with prescribed transport
records.review_note: The exact left-Caputo Volterra characteristic function and its complete complex zero multiset are required. Variable-order mixed derivatives with norming data, self-adjoint two-sided fractional operators and classical spatial Sturm–Liouville inverse results do not prove this one-spectrum theorem.
records.current_title: Can one Dirichlet spectrum determine a Caputo potential?

records.title: An electric far-field factorization criterion for a perfect conductor
records.former_aim_title: Boundary control to equilibrium for a parabolic obstacle problem
records.review_note: The target is the actual range of the unmodified electric far-field operator's quarter power for a PEC obstacle. Modified-operator, penetrable, static and waveguide factorization results avoid the middle-operator obstruction and do not establish this exact criterion.
records.current_title: An electric far-field factorization criterion for a perfect conductor

records.title: Smooth invertibility of weighted geodesic X-ray normal operators
records.former_aim_title: Logarithmic convexity for two coupled subdiffusion orders
records.review_note: The all-gamma singular-weight isomorphism theorem is known on disks and selected constant-curvature models. Tensor results on the Euclidean disk and asymptotically hyperbolic surfaces do not provide a suitable alpha-boundary-defining weight for every simple compact manifold.
records.current_title: Smooth invertibility of weighted geodesic X-ray normal operators

records.title: Boundedness of second-order TGV denoising for bounded data
records.former_aim_title: Logarithmic convexity for subdiffusion with non-gradient drift
records.review_note: ICTV boundedness controls a more restricted auxiliary field, and first-order TV clipping arguments do not apply to unsmoothed second-order TGV. The 2026 spatial-parameter work still assumes bounded solutions where required; no theorem for every bounded datum and a,b>0 located.
records.current_title: Boundedness of second-order TGV denoising for bounded data

records.title: Does finite equilibrium capacity force nondegenerate capacity?
records.former_aim_title: Spatial coexistence despite extinction in the mean-field game
records.review_note: The 2026 generic-geometry theorem gives nondegenerate multistationarity under extra conditions and only a bounded gain from degenerate roots; it does not equate the complete finite equilibrium capacity with nondegenerate capacity for every fixed network.
records.current_title: Does finite equilibrium capacity force nondegenerate capacity?

records.title: Invariant point processes for a branching random walk
records.former_aim_title: Consensus in the one-dimensional Axelrod model above the feature threshold
records.review_note: The August 2026 BBM classification concerns one reproduction mechanism and invariance under its full semigroup. Locally finite-intensity results and the opposite branching-convolution order do not classify every invariant point process for every offspring law in the stated assumptions.
records.current_title: Invariant point processes for a branching random walk

records.title: Optimal final-iterate rate for one-dimensional SGD with bounded unbiased gradients
records.former_aim_title: A periodic high-density limit for bounded-confidence opinion clusters
records.review_note: The latest 2026 one-dimensional SGD paper explicitly says its logarithmic counterexamples use gradients of size sqrt(T) and do not settle uniformly almost-surely bounded gradients. Its iid additive-noise positive theorem, deterministic results, smooth interpolation and different schedules do not cover arbitrary adapted bounded oracles with the specified constant step.
records.current_title: Optimal final-iterate rate for one-dimensional SGD with bounded unbiased gradients

excluded_candidates.former_aim_title: Logarithmic controlled bandwidth for locally analytic functions
